description: far / extreme LOW airborne dive to the keeper's physical LEFT. Live artwork = the preserved Pro sprite sources/LOW_DIVE_LEFT_RAW.png drawn MIRRORED, with no rotation, no limb edit, no warp; the mirrored orientation was the one that pointed the body at the ball in the live low-left test (35.8 deg from the real save vector on the far case, 18.3 deg on the best-effort case, against 75.7 and 98.6 for the original).
